svg.text: The DRAM data bus is bidirectional. Every turn costs ~12 ns of dead bus, so we batch reads and writes into long runs.
- read list empty and writes pending
- a read hit a pending write (RAW) that must drain first
- a write has aged past WR_AGE_LIMIT (starvation guard)
- req_last seen and reads are done
512 KB more SRAM buys 2.9% of 8 TB/s.
